<P STYLE="margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 10.115</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>LICENSE AGREEMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>Between</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>VG Life Sciences,
Inc.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>and</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>Scott &amp; White
Healthcare</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>PATENT LICENSE
AGREEMENT NO. SW11-003PLA</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">This agreement (&quot;Agreement&quot;) is made between VG Life
Sciences, Inc., a Delaware corporation with principal offices in San Marino, California, (&quot;LICENSEE&quot;) and Scott &amp;
White Healthcare, a Texas non profit corporation, with offices located at 2401 South 31st Street, Temple, TX 76508, on behalf of
itself and its Affiliates within its organizational structure (&quot;S&amp;W&quot;), collectively referred to as &quot;Parties&quot;
and individually as &quot;Party.''</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt">W I T N E S S E T H:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">WHEREAS, Dr. M. Karen Newell (&quot;Dr. Newell&quot;), an employee
of Texas A&amp;M University Health Science Center (&quot;HSC&quot;), has invented either jointly or singly certain intellectual
property while employed byHSC;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">WHEREAS, Dr. Newell, during the term of her employment at HSC,
has received salary support and other resources from S&amp;W;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">WHEREAS, HSC is a member of The Texas A&amp;M University System
(&quot;SYSTEM'') and SYSTEM has responsibility for administering its intellectual property;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 44pt">WHEREAS, S&amp;W and SYSTEM have executed an Interinstitutional
Agreement, dated March 3, 2008, to define the relationship of S&amp;W and SYSTEM as it relates to joint intellectual property and
transfers of rights therein, and that a Schedule 2 and a Schedule 8 (&quot;Schedules&quot;) to the Interinstitutional Agreement,
dated March 20,2010, grant S&amp;W the exclusive right to market and license the rights ofS&amp;W and System to certain intellectual
property invented or co-invented by Dr. Newell on behalf of S&amp;W and SYSTEM ;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">WHEREAS, SYSTEM and S&amp;W desire that such intellectual property
be commercialized for the public benefit and welfare; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">WHEREAS, LICENSEE has represented that it has certain marketing,
technical, and financial capabilities, and that it will undertake a thorough and diligent program of development and commercialization
of the LICENSED TECHNOLOGY; and</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">WHEREAS, S&amp;W is willing to grant to LICENSEE, and LICENSEE
is willing to accept, a license to use S&amp;W's and SYSTEM's rights in certain intellectual property invented or co-invented by
Dr. Newell, upon the terms and conditions below.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and
premises contained in this Agreement, the receipt and sufficiency of which is acknowledged, the Parties agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 22pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><U>ARTICLE I - DEFINITIONS</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">1.1</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&quot;AFFILIATE&quot; or &quot;AFFILIATES&quot; means any
entity that directly or indirectly owns or controls, is owned or controlled by, or under common ownership or control with a Party,
wherein &quot;owns&quot; as used in this definition means possession or the right to possession of at least 50% of the voting
stock of a corporation; and &quot;controls&quot; as used in this definition means (i) the power to direct the management and policies
of the entity or (ii) the power to appoint or remove a majority of the board of directors; or (iii) the right to receive 50% or
more of the profits or earnings.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">1.2</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&quot;PATENT RIGHTS&quot;&middot;&middot;means S&amp;W's
and SYSTEM's rights in Table 1 in this Paragraph 1.2, all U.S., PCT and foreign patent applications claiming priority thereto,
all patents issuing therefrom, reissues, reexaminations and any extensions of or supplementary protection certificates allowed
on any of the foregoing, in each case only to the extent of subject matter claimed that is fully disclosed and enabled by the
disclosures in the patent applications below to satisfy 35 U.S.C. &sect;112:</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><IMG SRC="ex1085_table1.jpg" ALT="">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">1.3</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&quot;PROPRIETARY INFORMATION&quot; means any know-how
and materials disclosed to Parties by Dr. Newell between March 20, 2010 and the Effective Date regarding the Patent Rights.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">1.4</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&quot;LICENSED PRODUCT&quot; or &quot;LICENSED PRODUCTS&quot;
means any product, process, or composition of matter that is within the scope of any VALID CLAIM of PATENT RIGHTS.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">1.5</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&quot;VALID CLAIM&quot; means and includes a claim of a
patent application or an unexpired patent or a patent whose expiration date has been extended by law, so long as the claim has
not been held invalid and/or unenforceable in an unappealable decision of a court or other authority of competent jurisdiction.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">1.6</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&quot;EFFECTIVE DATE.. means the date this Agreement has
been executed by the last Party.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">1.7</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">'&quot;NET SALES&quot; means LICENSEE's and SUBLICENSEE's
receipts for sales of LICENSED PRODUCTS or for services requiring the use of LICENSED PRODUCTS less the sum of the following:</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 22pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">sales taxes, tariffs, duties and/or use taxes directly
imposed with reference to particular sales;</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 22pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">outbound transportation prepaid or allowed; and</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 22pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">amounts allowed or credited on returns.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 22pt">Commissions paid to individuals, whether independent sales agents
or regularly employed by LICENSEE, and the cost of collections may not be deducted from NET SALES.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">1.8</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&quot;FIELD OF USE&quot; means all uses.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">1.9</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&quot;TERRITORY&quot; means world-wide.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">1.10</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&quot;LICENSEE&quot; means VG Life Sciences, Inc. and any
entity in which VG Life Sciences, Inc. has an equity ownership share at least seventy five percent (75%).</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">1.11</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&quot;SUBLICENSEE&quot; means any third party sublicensed
by LICENSEE to make, have made, use, have used, sell, have sold, import, have imported, exported, or have exported LICENSED TECHNOLOGY.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">1.12</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">&quot;LICENSED TECHNOLOGY&quot; means technology that falls
within the scope of any VALID CLAIM of PATENT RIGHTS or any PROPRIETARY INFORMATION.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt">ARTICLE II - LICENSE GRANT</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">2.1</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Grant</U>. S&amp;W grants LICENSEE an exclusive license
under PATENT RIGHTS to make, have made, use. and sell the LICENSED PRODUCTS in the FIELD OF USE in the TERRITORY, and to grant
sublicenses of the same scope, to the end of the term of this Agreement as prescribed in Article VIII.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">2.2</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Reservation</U>. S&amp;W on behalf of itself and SYSTEM
hereby reserves an irrevocable, nonexclusive, royalty-free right to practice the grant made in paragraph 2.1 for research, humanitarian,
and educational purposes only, and to grant sublicenses of the same scope, and not for commercial purposes or for the commercial
benefit of third parties.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">2.3</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Government Reservation</U>. To the extent that rights
under this Agreement are subject to rights required to be granted to the Government of the United States of America under 35 USC
Sections 200-212, such rights are so granted including a nonexclusive, nontransferable, irrevocable, paid-up license to practice
or have practiced for the United States the subject inventions throughout the world.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt">ARTICLE III - CONSIDERATION</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">3.1</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>License Fee</U>. In consideration for the license granted
in this Agreement, LICENSEE must make an initial payment in the amount fifty thousand dollars ($50,000) to S&amp;W. This payment
is due no later than sixty (60) days after the EFFECTIVE DATE. Failure to make this payment within the specified period will cause
this Agreement to immediately terminate.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">3.2</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Royalty Rate</U>. As additional consideration for the
license granted in this Agreement, LICENSEE must remit to S&amp;W a royalty of three percent (3%) of NET SALES in developed countries
and one half percent (0.5%) of NET SALES in underdeveloped countries. Underdeveloped countries shall mean any country which, at
the time the sale occurs, meets the definition of a developing country as defined by the World Bank. Developed countries shall
mean all countries other than underdeveloped countries as defined by the World Bank. LICENSEE may not accept anything of value
in lieu of money payment without the express written permission of S&amp;W. When calculating NET SALES, S&amp;W may assign fair
market value based upon comparable sales to receipts from transactions that are not made at fair market value.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">3.3</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>No Multiple Royalties</U>. No multiple royalties shall
be payable because any LICENSED PRODUCT is covered by more than one of the PATENT RIGHTS.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">3.4</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Reduction in Royalty Rate</U>. In the event that LICENSEE
must enter into a license with a third party and agrees to pay a royalty thereunder in order to make, use, or sell a LICENSED
PRODUCT or sublicense PATENT RIGHTS, then any such royalty shall be reduced by fifty percent (50%) of the royalty paid to said
third party for the same reporting period. However, in no event shall any such royalty be less than one half the otherwise applicable
royalties.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 66pt"><B>Diligence Milestones</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 66pt">1 . LICENSEE or a SUBLICENSEE at any Phase 1 clinical trial
for a Licensed Product/indication &middot;within 2 years of the effective date of the license agreement</P>

<!-- Field: Rule-Page --><DIV ALIGN="CENTER" STYLE="margin-top: 3pt; margin-bottom: 3pt"><DIV STYLE="font-size: 1pt; border-top: Black 1pt solid; width: 75%">&nbsp;</DIV></DIV><!-- Field: /Rule-Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 66pt"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 66pt">2. A Phase II clinical trial for a Licensed Product/indication
within two years following completion of a Phase clinical trial license agreement, but subject to approval by S&amp;W shall be
afforded more time if such is due to the nature of requirements met in Phase 1.</P>

</DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">5.3</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Failure to Accomplish Milestones</U>. Should LICENSEE
fail to achieve any milestone specified in paragraph 5.2, or should LICENSEE fail to record NET SALES for two (2) consecutive
Calendar Years once sales begin, S&amp;W, at its sole option, may waive the requirement to achieve the milestone, reduce the license
granted to a nonexclusive license, renegotiate the missed milestone, or terminate this Agreement under paragraph 8.3.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">5.3</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Legal Compliance</U>. LICENSEE must comply with all
applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations in its exercise of all rights granted by S&amp;W under this Agreement.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">5.4</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>U.S. Manufacture</U>. To the extent that rights under
this Agreement are subject to rights required to be granted to the Government of the United States of America under 35 USC &sect;&sect;
200-212, LICENSED PRODUCTS must be manufactured substantially in the United States of America.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><U>ARTICLE VI- PROTECTION OF INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">6.1</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Authorization</U>. As to prosecution, registration,
and/or protection of PATENT RIGHTS, S&amp;W hereby authorizes LICENSEE to: 1) direct the preparation and filing of patent applications,
2) direct the prosecution of broad patent claims for the mutual benefit of LICENSEE, S&amp;W, and SYSTEM, 3) maintain U.S. and
non-U.S. issued and granted patents, and 4) be invoiced directly by LICENSEE's outside patent counsel (as approved by S&amp;W
under paragraph 6.2 herein) and/or annuity service providers for patent prosecution and associated maintenance fees and costs.
S&amp;W may revoke this authorization at any time by giving ten (10) days written notice to LICENSEE.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">6.2</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Selection of Counsel</U>. LICENSEE may select an outside
patent counsel (Counsel) law firm staffed by experienced, reputable, and licensed intellectual property attorneys for the prosecution,
registration, protection, and maintenance of PATENT RIGHTS. LICENSEE will notify S&amp;W of its selection of Counsel and S&amp;W
will have final approval on such selection, and such approval shall not be unreasonably withheld.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">6.3</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Contract with Counsel</U>. LICENSEE shall execute a
written agreement with Counsel establishing that: 1) the attorney/client relationship relative to the prosecution, registration,
or protection of PATENT RIGHTS will be with S&amp;W and LlCENSEE jointly; 2) Counsel will not take any actions adverse to the
interests of S&amp;W in relation to PATENT RIGHTS including, for example and without limitation, any future invalidity or adverse
litigation actions; 3) costs for prosecution, registration, or protection of PATENT RIGHTS will be invoiced directly to LICENSEE
with a courtesy copy of the invoice lo S&amp;W; and 4) S&amp;W will not be responsible for payment of invoices relating to prosecution,
registration, or protection of PATENT RIGHTS conducted under this Agreement. including, without limitation, attorneys&middot;
fees, costs, official filing fees, and foreign associates' fees and costs. LICENSEE shall provide a copy of such written agreement
to S&amp;W. Additionally, LICENSEE shall ensure that Counsel promptly signs the standard Outside Counsel Agreement, which Counsel
can obtain from S&amp;W's Office of General Counsel.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">6.4</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Approvals. LICENSEE shall notify S&amp;W before any substantive
actions are taken in prosecuting, continuing, or abandoning any patents or patent applications or otherwise affecting PATENT RIGHTS
and LICENSEE will instruct Counsel to so notify S&amp;W. In addition to other substantive actions, LICENSEE agrees that S&amp;W
will have final approval on the filing of any action or application that seeks to, or effects, changes in inventorship related
to PATENT RIGHTS, and will so instruct Counsel. LICENSEE agrees that S&amp;W will have final approval on how to proceed with any
substantive actions relating to and/or affecting PATENT RIGHTS.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">6.5</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Patent Maintenance</U>. During the term of this Agreement,
LICENSEE shall be directly responsible for annual or periodic annuity payments to maintain the pendency of non-U.S. patent applications
in countries that require such annual or periodic annuities. Furthermore, during the term of this Agreement, LICENSEE agrees to
continue any required annual and periodic payments for maintenance of U.S. and non-U.S. issued and granted patents.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">6.6</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Patent Maintenance Contract</U>. LICENSEE shall engage
Counsel or a reputable annuity service to be responsible for docketing and payment of annual or periodic annuities and maintenance
fees for both U.S. and non-U.S. pending applications and U.S. and non-U.S. issued and granted patents during the term of this
Agreement.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">6.7</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Advance Payment of Maintenance Fees</U>. Should LICENSEE
request in writing that S&amp;W direct payment of annuities and/or maintenance fees relating to PATENT RIGHTS, LICENSEE agrees
to provide payment of estimates for such annuities/fees ninety (90) days in advance of the due date. LICENSEE agrees that failure
to make such timely advance payments to S&amp;\V shall be reasonably construed to be a decision to abandon such patent application
or patent and that S&amp;W has full rights to determine whether or not to pay the annuity or maintenance fees with no further
obligation to LICENSEE. Furthermore, should S&amp;W decide to continue maintenance of the patent application or patent at its
own expense, LICENSEE hereby agrees that any such application or patent will be excluded from PATENT RIGHTS.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">6.8</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Confidential Communications</U>. S&amp;W and LICENSEE
have a community of interest with regard to work conducted in relation to PATENT RIGHTS due to their common interest in the generation
of enforceable Intellectual Property rights relating to LICENSED PRODUCTS and/or LICENSED SERVICES. Any communications between
LICENSEE and Counsel shall not be confidential vis a-vis S&amp;W, but shall be otherwise confidential and protected by attorney
client privilege.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">6.9</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Correspondence</U>. LICENSEE shall contemporaneously
copy SYSTEM and S&amp;W on all correspondence to and from any patent office, U.S. or non-U.S., including all periodic annuities
and maintenance fees correspondence, and LICENSEE agrees to so instruct Counsel to provide copies of such correspondence to SYSTEM
and S&amp;W. LICENSEE further agrees that LICENSEE's failure to timely provide such correspondence will be considered a breach
of this Agreement in accordance with Paragraph 8.3 below.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">6.10</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Information</U>. To aid LICENSEE in the prosecution,
registration, protection, and maintenance of PATENT RIGHTS, S&amp;W will provide information, execute and deliver documents, and
perform other acts as LICENSEE reasonably requests from time to time. LICENSEE will reimburse S&amp;W for S&amp;W's reasonable
costs incurred in complying with such requests.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">6.11</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Abandonment</U>. Should LICENSEE decide to abandon any
U.S. or non-U.S. parent application or issued or granted patent for commercial reasons or by declining to make an annuity or maintenance
payment. LICENSEE shall immediately notify S&amp;W in writing, and S&amp;W shall have the right to continue patent prosecution
or maintenance at its own expense and any such patent application and granted or issued patent there from will be excluded from
PATENT RIGHTS in this License Agreement.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

granted herein.</TD>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><U>ARTICLE VII- PAYMENTS AND REPORTS</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">7.1</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>When Payments are Due</U>. Unless otherwise specified,
LICENSEE must make payments to Scott &amp; White Healthcare, in Temple, Texas, not later than sixty (60) days after the last day
of the calendar quarter in which they accrue.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">7.2</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Royalty Reports</U>. Beginning the first quarter in
which Net Sales occurs or sublicensing income is received, LICENSEE must provide a sales report to &amp;W each calendar quarter,
providing information sufficient to allow S&amp;W to calculate amounts due S&amp;W for the reporting period.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">7.3</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Currency</U>. Payment due to S&amp;W must be paid in
U.S. dollars. Royalty payments requiring conversion must use the exchange rate as reported in The Wall Street Journal on the last
business day of the royalty reporting period.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">7.4</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Inspection of Books and Records</U>. At its own expense,
S&amp;W may annually inspect LICENSEE's books and records as needed to determine royalties payable. LICENSEE must maintain those
books and records for at least three years following the dates of the underlying transactions. Any inspections will be in confidence
and conducted during ordinary business hours, and S&amp;W will provide LICENSEE advance notice two weeks before making an inspection.
S&amp;W may employ a Certified Public Accountant for this purpose. lf S&amp;W's audit identities a shortage of five percent (5%)
or more of amounts due to S&amp;W, then LICENSEE must pay the costs of S&amp;W's audit. LICENSEE must pay all amounts due as a
consequence of an audit to S&amp;W promptly, with interest.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">7.5</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Interest Charges</U>. S&amp;W may, in its sole discretion,
charge daily interest on overdue payments commencing on the 31st day after the payment is due, compounded monthly, at the lower
of either one and a half percent (1.5%) per month or the highest legal interest rate. The payment of interest will not foreclose
S&amp;W from exercising any other rights it may have due to the lateness of any payment.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><U>ARTICLE VIII - TERM AND TERMINATION</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">8.1</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Expiration</U>. This Agreement, unless sooner terminated
as provided below, will remain in effect until (a) expiration or the last to expire patent under PATENT RIGHTS, or (b) final and
unappealable determination by a court of competent jurisdiction that PATENT RIGHTS are invalid.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">8.2</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Termination by LICENSEE</U>. LICENSEE may terminate
this Agreement by providing written notice to S&amp;W at least ninety (90) days before the termination is to take effect.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

    <DIV STYLE="page-break-before: always; margin-top: 6pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: center; width: 100%">&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">8.3</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Termination by S&amp;W</U>. lf LICENSEE materially breaches
this Agreement, S&amp;W may give LICENSEE written notice of the breach. LICENSEE will have sixty (60) days from receipt of the
notice to cure the breach. lf LICENSEE does not cure the breach within this period, S&amp;W may terminate this Agreement without
further notice.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">8.4</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Matters Surviving Termination</U>. All accrued obligations
and claims, including license fee obligations, royalty obligations. minimum annual consideration obligations, interest charge
obligations, and all other financial obligations, and claims or causes of action for breach of this Agreement, will survive termination
of this Agreement. Obligations of confidentiality will survive termination of this Agreement This section controls in the case
of a conflict with any other section of this Agreement.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><U>ARTICLE IX - INDEMNIFICATION AND REPRESENTATION</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">9.1</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Indemnification</U>. LICENSEE MUST AT ALL TIMES DURING
AND AFTER THE TERM OF THIS AGREEMENT INDEMNIFY, DEFEND, AND HOLD HARMLESS SYSTEM AND S&amp;W, ITS REGENTS, OFFICERS, BOARD MEMBERS,
AND CURRENT AND FORMER EMPLOYEES AGAINST ANY CLAIM, PROCEEDING, DEMAND, LIABILITY OR EXPENSE (INCLUDING LEGAL EXPENSE AND REASONABLE
ATTORNEY'S FEES) WHICH RELATES TO INJURY TO PERSONS OR PROPERTY, ANY ACTION BROUGHT BY A THIRD PARTY ALLEGING INFRINGEMENT OF
INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS, OR AGAINST ANY OTHER CLAIM, PROCEEDING, DEMAND, EXPENSE, OR LIABILITY OF ANY KIND RESULTING FROM
TH PRODUCTION, MANUFACTURE, SALE, COMMERCIAL USE, LEASE, CONSUMPTION, OR ADVERTISEMENT OF LICENSED PRODUCTS OR ARISING FROM ANY
OBLIGATION OF LICENSEE OR SUBLICENSEE(S) UNDER THIS AGREEMENT.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">9.2</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Representation</U>. S&amp;W represents that it owns
and has title to, either solely, jointly with SYSTEM, or jointly with SYSTEM and LICENSEE, PATENT RIGHTS and has the full right
and power to grant the license in paragraph 2.1, and that there are no outstanding agreements, assignments, or encumbrances inconsistent
with the provisions of this Agreement. S&amp;W MAKES NO OTHER REPRESENTATIONS AND EXTENDS NO OTHER WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, EITHER
EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO WARRANTIES OF MERCANTABILITY OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, NOR DOES S&amp;W
ASSUME ANY OBLIGATION REGARDING INFRINGEMENT OF PATENT RIGHTS OR OTHER RIGHTS OF THIRD PARTIES DUE TO LICENSEE'S ACTIVITIES UNDER
THIS AGREEMENT.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><U>ARTICLE XI- PATENT INFRINGEMENT</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">11.1</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Notice of Infringement</U>. Each Party must promptly
notify the other in writing of any alleged infringement of PATENT RIGHTS that comes to its attention. Within sixty (60) days after
receipt of such notice, S&amp;W and LICENSEE will formulate a strategy for resolving the alleged infringement.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">11.2</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>LICENSEE Right to Bring Suit</U>. Following the initial
sixty (60) day strategy period pursuant to Paragraph 11.1, LICENSEE may institute suit for patent infringement against the infringer.
SYSTEM and/or S&amp;W may voluntarily join such suit at their own expense. but may not thereafter commence suit against the infringer
for the acts of infringement that are the subject of the LICENSEE's suit or any judgment rendered in that suit. LICENSEE may join
S&amp;W as a party in a suit initiated by LICENSEE if S&amp;W is a necessary party to the law suit under the procedural rules
of the applicable jurisdiction. If S&amp;W is involuntarily joined other than by the voluntary action of S&amp;W or is joined
as a necessary party as a matter of law, then LICENSEE will pay any costs incurred by S&amp;W arising out of such suit, including
but not limited to, any legal fees of the counsel that S&amp;W selects and retains to represent it in the suit; provided, however,
that S&amp;W shall endeavor to retain the same counsel as LICENSEE i n the same lawsuit subject to potential conflict of interests.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">11.3</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>S&amp;W Right to Bring Suit</U>. If, within a hundred
and ninety (90) days following the notice of infringement, LICENSEE has not brought suit against the infringer pursuant to Paragraph
11.2, then SYSTEM and/or S&amp;W may institute suit for patent infringement against the infringer. If SYSTEM and/or S&amp;W institutes
such suit, then LICENSEE may not join such suit without SYSTEM's or S&amp;W's consent and may not thereafter commence suit against
the infringer for the acts of infringement that are the subject of SYSTEM's and/or S&amp;W's suit or any judgment rendered in
that suit.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">11.4</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Control of Litigation</U>. Any litigation proceedings
will be controlled by the party bringing the suit.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">11.5</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Recovery</U>. Any recovery or settlement received in
connection with any suit will first be shared by S&amp;W and LICENSEE to cover any litigation costs each incurred, in proportion
to their respective costs. In any suit initiated by LICENSEE pursuant to Paragraph 11.2, any recovery in excess of litigation
costs will be shared between LICENSEE and S&amp;W as follows: (a) for any recovery other than amounts paid for willful infringement
or as punitive damages LICENSEE shall receive an amount equal to its lost profits or a reasonable royalty on the infringing sales,
or whichever measure of damages the court shall have applied, and LICENSEE shall pay to S&amp;W a portion of its recovery a reasonable
approximation of the royalties and other amounts that LICENSEE would have paid to S&amp;W if LICENSEE bad sold the infringing
products, processes and services rather than the infringer, and (b) as to amounts paid for willful infringement or as punitive
damages, SYSTEM will receive thirty percent (30%) of the recovery if S&amp;W was not a party in the litigation and did nor incur
any litigation costs that were not reimbursed by LICENSEE or fifty percent (50%) of the recovery if SYSTEM was a party in the
litigation whether joined as a party under the provisions of Paragraph 11.2 or voluntarily. In any suit initiated by SYSTEM and/or
S&amp;W pursuant to Paragraph 11.4, any recovery in excess of litigation costs will belong to SYSTEM and/or S&amp;W.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 0pt"><U>ARTICLE XI - MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">12.1</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Export Controls</U>. S&amp;W and SYSTEM are subject
to United States laws and regulations controlling the export of technical data, computer software laboratory prototypes and other
commodities, and its obligations under this Agreement arc contingent on compliance with applicable laws and regulations. The transfer
of certain technical data and commodities may require a license from the cognizant agency of the United States Government or written
assurances by LICENSEE that LICENSEE will not export data or commodities to certain countries without advance approval of such
agency. S&amp;W neither represents that a license will not be required nor that, if required, it will be issued.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">12.2</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Confidential Information</U>. Sales reports submitted
by LICENSEE under ARTICLE VII will be considered Confidential Information under this Agreement and not be disclosed by S&amp;W
to any third party except as may be required by law. If the Parties contemplate exchanging other information of a confidential
nature, they should enter into a separate confidentiality agreement.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">12.3</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Non-Use of Names</U>. LICENSEE may not use the names
or any adaptation of the names of Scott &amp; White Healthcare or SYSTEM, nor of any of its employees or members, in any advertising,
promotional, or sales literature without the advance written consent of S&amp;W and/or SYSTEM in each case, except that LICENSEE
may state that it is licensed by S&amp;W under PATENT RIGHTS.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">12.4</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Trademarks</U>. LICENSEE may select, own and use its
own trademark on LICENSED PRODUCTS. However, S&amp;W does not grant LICENSEE any license or other right under any trade name,
trademark or service mark owned or licensed by S&amp;W or SYSTEM. Conversely, S&amp;W has no rights to trade names, trademarks,
or service marks owned by LICENSEE.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">12.5</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Assignment of this Agreement</U>. This Agreement, with
the rights and privileges it creates, 1s assignable only with the written consent of both Parties.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">12.6</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Force Majeure</U>. Other than an obligation for the
payment of money, S&amp;W, upon receipt of documentation from LICENSEE which it deems appropriate, must excuse any breach of this
Agreement which is proximately caused by war, strike, act of God, or other similar circumstance normally deemed outside the control
of well-managed businesses.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">12.7</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Entire Agreement</U>. This Agreement contains the entire
understanding of the Parties regarding PATENT RIGHTS, and supersedes all other written and oral agreements between the Parties
regarding PATENT RIGHTS. It may be modified only by a written amendment signed by the Parties.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">12.8</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Governing Law</U>. The substantive Laws of the State
of Texas (and not its conflicts of law principles), USA, govern all matters arising out of or relating to this Agreement and all
of the transactions it contemplates. Venue for any suit brought against S&amp;W in Texas state court must be in Bell County, Texas,
and venue for any suit brought against S&amp;W in federal court must be in Texas.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 0pt"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 22pt; text-align: left">12.9</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><U>Headings</U>. Headings are solely for convenience of
reference and are not part of, and may not be used to construe, this Agreement.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

Agreement is invalid, illegal, or unenforceable, the validity, legality and enforceability of the remaining provisions will not
not in any way be affected or impaired. A waiver of any breach of this Agreement does not waive any other breach of the same or
